sn35.77:1.1: yaṃ kho rādha, dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.77:1.3: cakkhuṃ kho rādha, dukkhaṃ. tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.77:1.4: rūpā dukkhā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.77:1.5: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbā.
sn35.77:1.9: tatra te chando pahātabbo. yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati
sn35.77:1.10: vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā
sn35.77:1.11: tampi dukkhaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo …pe…
sn35.77:1.12: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampidukkhaṃ. tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.77:1.13: yaṃ kho rādha, dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti.
